scope: Production handler body with Node TypeScript stripping, actual Nodemailer 9.0.3 and a loopback SMTP receiver; Supabase calls use controlled fixtures. No external email sent.

cases.name: Invalid dispatcher token cannot claim or send
Real SMTP transport delivers MIME email to local-only inbox and records success
Disabled email preference cancels delivery without SMTP
Unverified recipient is rejected without SMTP
Missing SMTP password records failed delivery
SMTP recipient rejection records failure and accepts no message
Retry of the same job preserves Message-ID and succeeds after SMTP recovery
